whatIs.title: Who are we?
whatIs.description: Kazakh Hub is a code sharing and collaboration platform for Kazakhstani developers. We help develop the Kazakhstani IT community and knowledge exchange.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to create a convenient platform for Kazakhstani developers for code sharing, knowledge exchange, and collaboration. We support open source and rely on community development.

features.title: Our Features
features.codeSharing: Code sharing - easily share your code files
features.community: Community - join the Kazakhstani IT community

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: If you have any questions, please contact us. We value your feedback and suggestions.

features.codeSharingDesc: Easily share your code files with other developers
features.collaborationDesc: Work together with other developers on projects
features.learningDesc: Learn from others' code and develop your skills
features.friendsSystemDesc: Add friends and stay connected with them
